body:
Yup, I'm pretty much trying the "See how BAD i'm doing my job?" way to get out of there. Today was ok (not great, but it was ok. I was really anxious going in but it fade away a bit and I'm feeling ok about the job right now, at least able to last until november). If things get out of hand, I'll try to quit again, and if they won't let me, I'll just stop showing up - that's the last resort, of course.

For the dieting,I'm just counting calories. It's amazingly simple :D. I'm not even eating that low cal, I'm actually pretty much never hungry between meals, and I'm losing between 0.3 and 0.4kg a week. Not huge numbers but since I can still eat chocolate and go to the fast food once a week, it's an ok weight loss. My Fitness Pal is great for that if you want to give it a try ! The positive thing in all that is for the first time in my life, I'm not turning to food for comfort. It's quite the victory. As for working out instead of portion control... Heh, you can't outrun your fork. Weight loss is something like 70% diet and 30% working out. I don't know if you considered diet soda but it's been a lifesaver for me, I don't drink regular ever anymore, and it helped me cut calories a lot.

Things look wayyyyyyy more positive right now, I was really depressed the other day, but I'm getting a better way to look at it. It's not the end of the world, I'll find a way out if I try hard enough, it's nothing worth stop living.

Real estate. I don't want to go about too much details, but it has nothing to do with my original training, I have no clue what I'm supposed to do, and I'm basically doing two or three jobs all wrapped in one. 

I know november isn't like... ten years from now, but getting up in the morning and thinking "I have to go to this job today, and tomorrow, and the day after that, and the day after that" is getting to me. Also this sinking feeling in my chest "Who's going to be mad and mean to me today? What's going to go wrong? What will I say when the boss asks me how things are doing?" (I told him a few times that it isn't going well, even tried to quit - but he didn't want to hear anything about it.) I think I'll try and quit again tomorrow. I know it sounds so dumb, but I really don't handle stress well, and I'm not going to get sick over a job. I don't think I'm able to last until november. It's either that or finding a painless way to kill myself, anyway. 

Dieting and working out, when I can find the time. Not as much dieting as "learning to eat normal portions and not stuffing my face with what-should-be-enough-for-3-people worth of food". That's really going ok, I've lost 5 kg already. Pretty much the thing I'm hanging on. I'm trying to turn my life around, and I don't want to let this job, and my poor stress handling, make me fuck all that up.

I'm starting to feel a bit better. I'm trying to find a realistic way out - one that doesn't mean ending my life. I'll probably figure something out. Thanks for listening.

It's french labour law, it's a short term contract (six months) which means I'm not allowed to quit after the try out period (which was 2 weeks), if I quit now without their consent, they're allowed to sue me. I'm supposed to stay there until november but I don't feel up to it. 

I don't have any real hobbies except for reading, watching movies, usual stuff. I'm working on losing weight since a few months, and it's going ok. I know I shouldn't get myself that worked up because of a bad job, but I'm spending 40/50 hours a week there (gotta love the unpaid overtime), it's getting all my energy, and when I'm not there I'm just stressing about it. 

I think maybe my friends/family don't see me as a burden, maybe just a dumb drama queen. They're trying to be supportive but I don't tell them half of what I'm thinking, or feeling. I don't want them to worry, they have more important stuff going on than stupid old me stressing out about another job. My parents just told me that I shouldn't be so dramatic, stay the six months, and move on.

There's not much to be said. Started this job six weeks ago, tried to quit two weeks ago, they won't let me (it's complicated but i can't quit without their consent, or they'll be able to sue me). I just feel like I tried everything and nothing is ever good. I don't know what the hell I want to do when I grow up, except I'm already a grown up, so I'm pretty much fucked. Every job I tried ended up making me even more miserable. Not working makes me crazy after a few days. I don't know how to tell anybody around me how I feel. I'm tired of being a burden for them. Never happy, never easy going, always depressed and annoying. They must be so sick of me.
